data.description: The Roundhill MSFT WeeklyPay ETF (“MSFW”) is designed for investors seeking a combination of income and growth potential. MSFW aims to provide weekly distributions and calendar week returns, before fees and expenses, equal to 1.2 times (120%) the calendar week total return of Microsoft common shares (Nasdaq: MSFT). MSFW is an actively-managed ETF.
